relationships.subject: Follistatin
relationships.evidence_quote: The biolayer interferometry (BLI) assay and coimmunoprecipitation (co-IP) demonstrated direct binding of FST to the insulin-like growth factor-1 receptor (IGF1R)

relationships.subject: IGF1R
relationships.evidence_quote: IGF1R inhibition reduced FST-induced activation of extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) and protein kinase B (AKT)

relationships.subject: Follistatin
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal or intraplantar injection of recombinant FST, or overexpression of FST in the dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons, induced pain hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: Follistatin
relationships.evidence_quote: FST, released from A-fiber neurons, enhances Nav1.7-mediated hyperexcitability of nociceptive neurons by binding to IGF1R

key_findings: FST is upregulated in A-fiber sensory neurons after SNL; its inhibition or deletion alleviates neuropathic pain.
FST binds IGF1R to enhance Nav1.7-mediated nociceptor hyperexcitability; an FST-derived peptide blocking this attenuates pain.
